title: Delirium vs Dementia
source: Davidson's Principles and Practice of Medicine, 24th ed (2022): Box 31.1 p1236; p1246-1249; p1252; p1302-1305 (Box 34.11); p1138; p1247. Hook line and closing CTA are not from the book.

beats.vo: Dadaji achanak confuse ho gaye, ghar wale bole, budhapa hai. Galat! Ye delirium ho sakta hai. Aaj samjho dono ka fark, sabse simple tarike se.
Dono psychiatric disorders hain, ICD-10 ke pehle block mein: organic mental disorders.
Delirium matlab achanak aayi confusion, kisi bimari ya dawa se. Dementia matlab dheere dheere yaaddasht aur soch ka jaana, itna ki roz ke kaam bigdein.
beats.leftSub: kisi bimari ya dawa ki wajah se
beats.right: Dheere dheere yaaddasht aur soch ka jaana

beats.title: Shuruaat
beats.vo: Pehla fark, shuruaat. Delirium achanak, ghanton ya dinon mein. Dementia dheere, mahinon ya saalon mein.

beats.title: Course
beats.vo: Doosra, course. Delirium upar neeche hota rehta hai. Dementia lagataar badhta hai.

beats.title: Pehli problem
beats.vo: Teesra, pehli problem. Delirium mein dhyan nahi tikta. Dementia mein pehle yaaddasht jaati hai.

beats.title: Hosh
beats.vo: Chautha, hosh. Delirium mein hosh dhundhla. Dementia mein patient alert.

beats.title: Hallucinations
beats.vo: Paanchwa, hallucinations. Delirium mein aksar cheezein dikhti hain. Dementia mein dikhein, to Lewy body socho.

beats.title: Wajah
beats.vo: Chhatha, wajah. Delirium ke peeche acute bimari ya dawa, jaise infection ya alcohol withdrawal. Dementia ke peeche brain ki dheemi bimari, jaise Alzheimer's.

beats.title: Theek hoga?
beats.vo: Saatwa, kya theek hoga? Delirium aksar theek ho jata hai. Dementia mostly nahi.

beats.title: Test
beats.vo: Aathwa, test. Delirium ke liye 4AT. Dementia ke liye MoCA. Aur haan, dono saath bhi ho sakte hain.

beats.fact: Hospital ka har 4th patient delirium se guzarta hai
beats.vo: Ab myths. Myth one: budhape mein confusion normal hai. Nahi! Hospital mein har chautha patient delirium se guzarta hai.

beats.fact: Chupchaap hypoactive delirium sabse zyada miss hota hai
beats.vo: Myth two: delirium matlab shor machana. Nahi! Chupchaap hypoactive delirium sabse zyada miss hota hai.

beats.fact: Roz ke kaam na bigdein to dementia nahi. Depression bhi dementia jaisa dikhta hai
beats.vo: Myth three: bhoolna matlab dementia. Nahi! Roz ke kaam na bigdein, to dementia nahi. Depression bhi dementia jaisa dikh sakta hai.

beats.fact: Delirium aage dementia ka bada risk factor hai
beats.vo: Myth four: delirium theek, kahani khatam. Nahi! Delirium aage dementia ka bada risk factor hai.
Ab management. Delirium mein cause dhoondo aur theek karo, dawayein check karo, ghadi, chashma aur family se orient karo. Paani, khana, neend ka dhyan. Sedation pehla ilaaj nahi.

items: Theek hone wale causes: B12, thyroid, depression
Alzheimer's: dawa progression slow karti hai
beats.vo: Dementia mein pehle B12, thyroid aur depression jaise theek hone wale causes dekho. Patient aur family ko support do. Alzheimer's mein dawa progression thoda slow karti hai.
Exam ke liye ek line. Delirium: achanak, fluctuating, attention gaya. Dementia: dheere, progressive, patient alert.
Save karo, aur us dost ko bhejo jo dono ko same samajhta hai.
